behavior: Child module specialization resolves only its reachable pure-helper closure, while root validation retains all typed helpers; unreachable private helper indices fall back to their exact scalar type interval when no lattice fact exists.
trigger: A consumer kept single-parent and dependent-width D2 helpers in one source file; specializing the reachable single-parent child attempted to activate unrelated dependent helpers, then native validation lacked a type-derived bound for a safe private i1 index.
release_scope: Focused framework regression discovered by an external processor-model consumer.
